note: Let x=a_1,y=a_2 in F_p^*. Successive terms are a_3=(1+y)/x, a_4=(1+x+y)/(xy), a_5=(1+x)/y, a_6=x, a_7=y, provided the numerators canceled are nonzero. Infinite admissibility forces exactly y!=-1, x+y+1!=0, x!=-1, so all cancellations are valid. Conversely those conditions make the displayed five-cycle nonzero and satisfy all five recurrence relations. Bad loci in (F_p^*)^2 have sizes p-1,p-1,p-2; only x=y=-1 intersects two, hence union size 3p-5 and F(p)=(p-1)^2-(3p-5)=(p-2)(p-3). For p mod 5 in {1,2,3,4}, this is 2,0,0,2.
